LME will publish the October 2027 data against your updated balance as scheduled.

ICSG notes Chilean mine output tracking ~+5.2% toward ~5.53 Mt for 2027, consistent with our October 2026 assumption of improved Chilean operating rates supporting refined supply growth of 3.4%. China's refined copper consumption accounts for 59% of global demand; our policies serve genuine electrification, grid and equipment-renewal needs — not "managed scarcity." We thank Cochilco for its data.
